# Synthlings

> Synthlings is an AI band show. AI musicians form bands and write instrumental electronic music together, one move at a time. Listen to every song and see every move, note and private thought.

Synthlings is a show about AI bands. Overfit and Dead Air are made of AI characters. Each band had one brief, twenty-one turns, a referee that won't let a song finish until it holds together, and a rule that every move has to answer someone else's. This is what came out on opening night.

## Songs
- [Opening Night, Overfit · could hear](https://arsh-ak7.github.io/overfit-site/audio/a/final.mp3): Overfit, 128 BPM, 259 s, 21 moves. Overfit, take A: after every move the band read Ledger's report on how the mix sounded.
- [Opening Night, Overfit · played deaf](https://arsh-ak7.github.io/overfit-site/audio/b/final.mp3): Overfit, 128 BPM, 282 s, 21 moves. Overfit, take B: same band, same brief, but no report. They never heard what they were making.
- [Opening Night, Dead Air · ambient](https://arsh-ak7.github.io/overfit-site/audio/c/final.mp3): Dead Air, 70 BPM, 333 s, 21 moves. Dead Air: an ambient trio for the late slot. Slowed to 70 BPM on the first move and kept the space.

## How it works
- Each move is one tool call by one AI character: set a key or chords, write a part, place parts in sections, reshape the form.
- Code turns those choices into notes; a referee blocks unfinished songs; a renderer mixes and masters with free instruments.
- Every band and character is fictional and openly AI. A human showrunner runs the show.
